description: 115年度94處大規模崩塌潛勢區影響範圍 [landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps] (series on Taiwan Government Open Data Platform) is a series of datasets listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 提供115年度94處大規模崩塌潛勢區影響範圍shp下載檔案，包含lslno(潛勢區編號)、Twd97X(潛勢區形心座標X軸)、Twd97Y(潛勢區形心座標Y軸)、County(主要保全住戶所在縣市)、Town(主要保全住戶所在鄉鎮市區)、Vill(主要保全住戶所在村里)、 Address(保全住戶地址)、TotalRes(保全住戶總... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2026-01-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
